# Warsaw Viewpoints by explore.warsaw

> Warsaw Viewpoints is the first guide to the best viewpoints of Warsaw, written in English by Nikol Chmelickova, an expat living in Warsaw. 50 places on 120 pages: rooftops, cafes, restaurants, lookouts and observation decks, with pictures, addresses, opening times and an online digital map. A great gift or souvenir. The first batch of the hardcover is limited.
